parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set firewall family inet filter acl2010.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet filter acl2010.command: set firewall family inet filter acl2010 term 1 from source-address 10.1.1.0/24
set firewall family inet filter acl2010.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的源地址条件。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 防火墙过滤器的条件项编号。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 源地址的子网掩码位数。

set firewall family inet filter acl2010.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter acl2010.command: set firewall family inet filter acl2010 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet filter acl2010.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 防火墙过滤器的条件项编号。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 匹配条件后的动作，例如accept。

set firewall family inet filter acl2010.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter acl2010.command: set firewall family inet filter acl2010 term default then discard
set firewall family inet filter acl2010.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的默认动作。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 防火墙过滤器的默认条件项。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 默认条件后的动作，例如discard。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 172.19.139.2/30
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
